visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short dark hair and a black T-shirt sits in a brightly lit studio or office setting. He holds a smartphone toward the camera, demonstrating its screen. In the background, there is a desk with a large water bottle, a microphone arm, and office blinds. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the smartphone screen, showing a LINE chat interface with green and blue bubbles. The male's fingers interact with the screen, navigating to settings. (3) Digital screen capture view of the LINE app interface. The background is being changed to a custom image consisting of a dense, chaotic wall of Chinese text. (4) The scene returns to the male holding the phone, tilting it back and forth to show how the text-heavy background masks the chat content. He smiles and gestures with his free hand while pointing at the screen. (5) The male laughs and looks towards someone off-camera to his left. He shows the phone screen which now displays various versions of the text-wall background. (6) A hand belonging to an unseen person enters from the right, pointing at the phone screen. The male character continues to demonstrate the 'privacy' effect, gesturing enthusiastically.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The master track begins with a high-arousal male vocal introducing a 'trick.' The speech is rapid and enthusiastic, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a clear kick drum and synth bass. (2) A 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the screen recording appears. The primary speaker's voice remains dominant with high articulation clarity. (3) A distinct 'pop' UI sound effect plays as a menu item is selected. Background laughter from an off-camera male provides a comedic reaction bed. (4) The speaker's pitch rises during a humorous observation about the text-wall background. A 'ding' SFX punctuates the realization of how chaotic the background looks. (5) Fast-cut editing is reflected in the audio with short vocal fragments and frequent digital sound effects mimicking app interactions. (6) The BGM continues steadily as the main speaker gives a final call-to-action to follow his Instagram, ending with a final bright synthesizer chord and a comedic 'thud' sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Demonstration -> Comedic Interaction -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a humorous 'privacy hack' for the LINE messaging app, suggesting that users can use a chaotic wall of text as their chat background to make it difficult for others to read their messages. The primary objective is to engage viewers with creative tech tips while driving traffic to the creator's Instagram for a limited-time free download of the backgrounds shown.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Self-promotion for own Instagram content, not a third-party paid product placement.
